utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Leo, have you heard about the repair drive? I just found out from Cleo—it sounds like a great way to get to know folks around here.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Nell, yeah, I'm all in for that repair drive! Got my toolbox ready to go—want to lend a hand with that squeaky park gate?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure, Gus! I'd love to help—just point me at that gate and I'll see what I can do with my old wrench.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Rosa, did you hear the repair drive's been moved to Sunday at the community center? That gives us an extra day to dig out our broken things!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's right, Tess! I've been spreading the word—it's Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I'm glad you've been telling folks, Rosa—I nearly missed it myself with the date change!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No, no, I didn't mean anything. Just... thinking out loud.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Uli, you had a good point earlier—do you know if anyone's brought in extra duct tape yet, or should I add it to our request list?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think the supply closet might have some. I saw a roll in there last week.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I really think we need a detailed list before anyone starts hauling stuff over—last time we had three extra toolboxes and no sandpaper.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Totally agree, Pia—I've been chatting with folks like Vik and Bo to see what they're bringing so we can sort it out ahead of time.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, so let's set a timeline too—if we know who's coming when, we can keep the driveway clear.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late, Mina—what's the plan for the repair drive? I need to catch up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It's moved to Sunday at the community center now. You need to pick it up from Alex.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sunday at the community center—got it. Where do I find Alex to pick it up?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I'll make sure to rally the morning crew, Quinn. Can I count on you to bring your toolkit?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! I think I have some old tools in my garage. Do we need those?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely, Oren! Any spare tools would be a huge help. Could you bring them by Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Bo, I want to be sure—are we starting the fence repair at 10 sharp and then pausing when the supplies arrive at noon?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, 10 sharp works for me. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, Bo, I'll be there at 10 sharp. Let's stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, I just want to double-check: is the repair drive this Saturday for the community garden water pump, or are people also bringing random appliances like Vik mentioned?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Well, from what I've heard, it's mostly about the community garden pump, but folks like Vik are planning to bring other stuff too—Bo at the store mentioned the part situation's improving, so might be a good time for both.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Okay, so both things are happening? I want to make sure we still have enough volunteers for the pump specifically—did you hear if anyone else signed up?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hello Leo! Are you coming to the repair drive? It's at the lot behind the center, you know.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Repair drive? What's broken? I haven't heard anything about this.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, you haven't heard? It's to fix that old drainage ditch near the park—it's been flooding every time it rains.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I can help with that. I like keeping things in order.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Rey! I'll put you down for sorting and organizing the tools. You're a lifesaver!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, I'll be there Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Sam, are you going to the repair drive? I'm planning to bring my old lawnmower!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, I'll be there! Just waiting on Alex for the drive, but I'll have everything set for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh great, I'm definitely bringing my old blender and broken lamp too!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Repair drive? Sorry, I think I missed something. What's going on?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You didn't hear? Mark was saying we need some fancy repair drive to fix the main water line. But I'm not convinced it'll do anything we can't handle with our own equipment.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, a water line thing? I thought it was for the community center... I guess I'm behind on this one too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I'm actually sorting through the donation list right now. Do you have any spare tools or duct tape we could use?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I've got a roll of duct tape and a few screwdrivers I can bring. Is there anything else you're short on?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, that'll help a lot! I'm still waiting on a few more items like extra batteries and a hammer, but we're making good progress.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: So Bo, you decide what you're bringing to the repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I'm gonna drop off some duct tape. Figured it's always useful.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Nice thinking, Bo! I bet there'll be plenty of stuff that just needs a little duct tape magic.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No, no, I didn't mean to interrupt. Just... thinking out loud.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: No worry at all, Uli! Actually, it's perfect timing—I was just about to remind you the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, so you can definitely bring that toaster you mentioned.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, um, a toaster? I don't remember saying that...

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I've already posted in the parents’ group and got a few confirmations—looks like we'll have a solid morning crew this Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, Faye! That's exactly what we needed. I knew I could count on you!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Happy to help, Quinn! I'll keep an eye out for any more volunteers at drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Hana, did you see if anyone's signed up to bring the measuring tape and levels? We'll be in a real pickle if we have to start the fence repair without those.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hold on, Pia—are we talking about the fence repair or the repair drive? I want to make sure I've got the right tools in mind.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, you're right to check—the repair drive's the big picture, but the fence repair is part of it. Either way, we need those measuring tools, or we'll be guessing at fence posts.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Ira, I only just heard about this repair drive from Mrs. Gable—do you know what they're hoping to fix up?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven't heard much either, just that it's this weekend. I think Vik is bringing his lawnmower.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, a lawnmower? That must be for the overgrown lot behind the community center, then.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! I think I have some old tools in my garage. Do we need those?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Well, they might come in handy! But the big news is they moved it to Sunday at the community center, so we've got an extra day to get things ready.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sunday, you say? I'll have to check my calendar—I thought it was Saturday, but that gives me more time to find those wrenches!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Leo, just checking — you still plan to bring those old tools for the repair drive this Saturday, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Huh? What repair drive? I think you've got the wrong guy.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, sorry Leo, I must have mixed you up with someone else. No worries!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh hey Opal! I'm definitely bringing my old blender and broken lamp to the repair drive this Saturday, you going too?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yeah, I'll be there! Just make sure you head to the lot behind the community center—that's where we're setting up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I'll see you there with my blender and lamp!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Kira! Yeah, I'm all set to bring my old tools this Saturday — Alex is dropping off the repair drive by noon, so we'll have everything we need.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you sure that repair drive is actually going to fix the problem, or are we just wasting our time?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I think it'll work — Alex knows what he's doing, and we've used similar drives before. Let's see what happens Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: So the drive's arriving at noon—does that mean we're starting the fence repair at 10 sharp and pausing when the supplies come in?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, that sounds right. I'll have my tools ready at 10, and we can break when the truck rolls in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, good. I'll have my post-hole digger ready at the community center sharp at 10 a.m. Saturday.
